geopolitics_summary: EU faces acute summer energy crunch from extreme heat, nuclear/hydro outages, and low gas reserves ahead of winter.

themes.headline: Romania nuclear reactor shutdown due to record-low Danube water levels
themes.why_it_matters: Loss of baseload generation during peak-demand summer heat. Danube cooling constraint signals extended nuclear derate risk into autumn; drives marginal fuel switching to gas. Immediate DA/intraday price pressure in SE Europe.

themes.headline: Germany's low gas reserves risk winter shortages and higher consumer costs
themes.why_it_matters: Direct TTF driver. Delayed summer injection into storage amid high demand threatens Q4/Q1 gas adequacy. Forces storage arbitrage tightening and LNG demand competition; elevates Cal+1 gas curve and power dark-spread risk.

themes.headline: French nuclear plant disrupted by jellyfish; record reactor outages this summer
themes.why_it_matters: Recurring climate-driven constraint on French nuclear baseload. Reinforces structural hydro/nuclear deficit into autumn. Tightens French/German power curve; elevates need for gas-fired backup and cross-border imports, pressuring TTF-to-power spread.

themes.headline: US natural gas production forecast to hit 122.5 Bcf/d, a new record in 2026
themes.why_it_matters: Elevated US natgas supply eases global LNG availability for Atlantic arbitrage. Lower US Henry Hub floors TTF-to-LNG arb, reducing LNG inbound volumes to NW Europe and weakening Q4 gas curve—bearish for EU power forwards via lower fuel-stack switching costs.

themes.headline: US Senate passes Russia sanctions bill; House vote in September remains uncertain
themes.why_it_matters: Potential escalation of Russia/US sanctions landscape. If enacted, could reinforce LNG supply tightness (less US exports to allies) or amplify indirect sanctions risk on Russian LNG exports—indirect TTF/EUA volatility transmission via geopolitical premium and supply reallocation.
